artifacts.name: test_distinct_job_ids_create_distinct_files_in_same_clock_second
artifacts.description: A07 produces two different final paths and bytes for explicit UUID job identities independent of wall-clock time.

artifacts.name: test_repeated_job_id_never_overwrites_existing_audio
artifacts.description: Reusing one UUID raises FileExistsError and preserves the original final bytes.

artifacts.name: test_omitted_output_id_uses_unique_uuid_filenames
artifacts.description: Backward-compatible direct calls without output_id receive distinct canonical UUID filenames.

artifacts.name: test_invalid_output_id_cannot_create_paths
artifacts.description: Non-UUID and traversal-like identifiers fail before output-directory or provider work.

artifacts.name: test_legacy_server_tools_publish_with_persisted_job_ids
artifacts.description: Real in-memory MCP calls for both legacy generation tools persist jobs whose output filenames contain those same job UUIDs.

artifacts.name: test_export_and_link_failures_cleanup_temporary_files
artifacts.description: Export and non-collision finalization failures leave no temporary or final artifact and do not disturb existing files.
